summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Morning. Astra opens the pilot-status review packet while sorting ordinary work orders. Middle image: Pixa reads the timing. Closing image: Astra looks from the future of the station to the temporary repair holding part of it together.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Morning. Astra opens the pilot-status review packet while sorting ordinary work orders.
PANEL 2 — Header: STARDUST STATION — PROGRAM DISPOSITION REVIEW.
PANEL 3 — Pixa reads the timing. PIXA: Recommendation window closes in four hours.
PANEL 4 — Zib enters carrying the temporary-bracket inspection tag and a real wrench. ZIB: Bracket inspection is also today.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks from the future of the station to the temporary repair holding part of it together. ASTRA: Of course it is.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The review packet presents Option One: DEDICATED MATERIAL PILOT / BUDGET: INCREASED / PROCUREMENT: PRIORITY / OUTPUT TARGETS: REQUIRED. Middle image: Jax reads all three. Closing image: Astra looks at the three boxes.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The review packet presents Option One: DEDICATED MATERIAL PILOT / BUDGET: INCREASED / PROCUREMENT: PRIORITY / OUTPUT TARGETS: REQUIRED.
PANEL 2 — Option Two: LOW-PRIORITY OPERATIONS / PILOT SUPPORT: ENDS / PROCUREMENT: STANDARD / FUTURE SITE REVIEW: LIKELY.
PANEL 3 — Option Three: CONSOLIDATE OPERATIONS / CLOSE SITE.
PANEL 4 — Jax reads all three. JAX: Strong menu.
PANEL 5 — Glorp scrolls for another standard option. GLORP: There is no fourth selection.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at the three boxes. ASTRA: Then we have four hours to make one.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Zib opens the coolant-balancing unit. Middle image: Zib taps the procurement status: REPLACEMENT PART ETA: 12 DAYS. Closing image: Zib notices.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib opens the coolant-balancing unit.
PANEL 2 — The approved clamp is still carrying the load. The incidental filler remains only in the gap.
PANEL 3 — Mira checks the old sample record beside the current inspection. MIRA: Temporary repair still within monitored limits.
PANEL 4 — Zib taps the procurement status: REPLACEMENT PART ETA: 12 DAYS.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at Option One's priority procurement promise on the review slate she brought with her.
PANEL 6 — Zib notices. ZIB: Still no. ASTRA: I know.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Astra closes the three-option review slate and sets it face-down on Zib's workbench beside the inspection tools. Middle image: Astra looks out toward the working station. Closing image: Astra points at him specifically.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra closes the three-option review slate and sets it face-down on Zib's workbench beside the inspection tools.
PANEL 2 — On the back of an ordinary work-order sheet she writes one question by hand: WHAT CAN WE PROVE?
PANEL 3 — Mira draws two plain columns beneath it: OPERATIONS / MATERIAL.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks out toward the working station. ASTRA: No pitch language. Bring me things we can defend.
PANEL 5 — Brick opens his notebook with immediate enthusiasm.
PANEL 6 — Astra points at him specifically. ASTRA: Evidence we can defend. Brick slowly closes it again while Zib keeps inspecting the bracket.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra and Pixa move through the working operations level while normal jobs continue around them; Pixa calls out only measures tied to visible work. Middle image: Pixa answers while moving with them. Closing image: Pixa adds the plain operational fact without interpretation.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra and Pixa move through the working operations level while normal jobs continue around them; Pixa calls out only measures tied to visible work.
PANEL 2 — Jax closes an access route behind a finished task as Pixa notes incident detection time and accepted local ownership.
PANEL 3 — Zib closes a service panel as Pixa notes repair closure and repeat-incident rate. Astra asks: No morale score.
PANEL 4 — Pixa answers while moving with them. PIXA: None exists.
PANEL 5 — Mira stops at the cargo-delay entry and points at it. MIRA: Include the cargo delay.
PANEL 6 — Pixa adds the plain operational fact without interpretation. PIXA: Eleven-minute delay associated with output-oriented schedule change.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Zib wheels over the actual stained work board. Middle image: Zib points at the closed column. Closing image: Zib points at open work orders.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib wheels over the actual stained work board.
PANEL 2 — It is full of mundane closed items accumulated on the board: stabilizer, microwave ground, wall panel, damper, vent, hatch, galley manifold, Dock 2 sensor.
PANEL 3 — Astra studies the handwritten corrections, crossed-out notes and magnets. ASTRA: This is ugly.
PANEL 4 — Zib points at the closed column. ZIB: This is work.
PANEL 5 — Mira holds the inconsistent material-sample chart beside the work board.
PANEL 6 — Zib points at open work orders. ZIB: We know how to make this number go down.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Mira lays the season's retained samples and test pieces across the lab bench in physical order, from brittle fragments to the limited-use filler sample. Middle image: Mira seals a sample case. Closing image: Astra reads the handwritten line, then looks at Mira.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira lays the season's retained samples and test pieces across the lab bench in physical order, from brittle fragments to the limited-use filler sample.
PANEL 2 — Beside each sample are short test cards: properties vary; yield inconsistent; mass does not predict quality; mechanism unresolved.
PANEL 3 — Astra asks across the bench. ASTRA: What can we promise?
PANEL 4 — Mira seals a sample case. MIRA: Collection and characterization.
PANEL 5 — Mira takes the proposal sheet and writes one exact boundary herself: NO INFERRED EMOTIONAL FIELDS.
PANEL 6 — Astra reads the handwritten line, then looks at Mira. ASTRA: Keep that exact.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Cargo Bay / Dock 2. Opening image: Jax walks Astra to the cargo lane and opens the route history on his route slate beside the actual conveyor they serviced early. Middle image: JAX: When collection became the reason for the job, the actual route got worse. Closing image: Jax sends the Dock 2 access-log entry from the route slate to Astra's review packet.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax walks Astra to the cargo lane and opens the route history on his route slate beside the actual conveyor they serviced early.
PANEL 2 — He traces the accelerated conveyor closure and then the Dock 2 problem that arrived while the lane was unnecessarily occupied.
PANEL 3 — Medium close on Jax beside the route slate, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. JAX: When collection became the reason for the job, the actual route got worse.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks down the lane where she made the call and does not defend herself. ASTRA: Yes.
PANEL 5 — Jax sends the Dock 2 access-log entry from the route slate to Astra's review packet. JAX: Then use that.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Glorp spreads the actual sample labels, custody slips and local disclosure cards from the season across a desk; Kreeb removes individual personal text before anything is copied forward. Middle image: Glorp looks at the empty area. Closing image: Glorp stamps the form: BEHAVIORAL CONTEXT: NOT REQUIRED.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp spreads the actual sample labels, custody slips and local disclosure cards from the season across a desk; Kreeb removes individual personal text before anything is copied forward.
PANEL 2 — Glorp writes the required operational fields on a clean form: owner; task; physical condition; chain of custody; unresolved questions.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb leaves deliberate physical space beneath them for optional disclosure and writes: no behavioral condition required; intentional blank permitted.
PANEL 4 — Glorp looks at the empty area. GLORP: This still makes me uncomfortable.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb looks at the blank paper too. KREEB: Leave it blank on purpose.
PANEL 6 — Glorp stamps the form: BEHAVIORAL CONTEXT: NOT REQUIRED. GLORP: More durable.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The workbench now holds Zib's board, Jax's route slate, Mira's sample cards and Glorp/Kreeb's reporting form around the original WHAT CAN WE PROVE? sheet. Middle image: Astra crosses out the S with a pen. ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS / INCIDENTAL MATERIAL OBSERVATION. Closing image: Astra accepts that.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The workbench now holds Zib's board, Jax's route slate, Mira's sample cards and Glorp/Kreeb's reporting form around the original WHAT CAN WE PROVE? sheet.
PANEL 2 — Astra writes a provisional heading across the top of the physical sheet: ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS / INCIDENTAL MATERIALS OBSERVATION.
PANEL 3 — Mira reads it. MIRA: Materials plural?
PANEL 4 — Astra crosses out the S with a pen. ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS / INCIDENTAL MATERIAL OBSERVATION.
PANEL 5 — Zib looks at the handwriting. ZIB: Still sounds like a department.
PANEL 6 — Astra accepts that. ASTRA: Today we need it to.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra folds the sheet into two literal sections: PRIMARY FUNCTION / SECONDARY OBSERVATION. Middle image: Mira adds in ink: NO OUTPUT TARGET. Closing image: Pixa reads the whole physical packet before it is digitized.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra folds the sheet into two literal sections: PRIMARY FUNCTION / SECONDARY OBSERVATION.
PANEL 2 — Under Primary she writes: STATION OPERATIONS / ADAPTIVE RESPONSE / MAINTENANCE CLOSURE, then clips Zib's work-order evidence beneath it.
PANEL 3 — Under Secondary Mira writes: PASSIVE MATERIAL COLLECTION / PHYSICAL CHARACTERIZATION, then sets one sealed sample card beneath it.
PANEL 4 — Mira adds in ink: NO OUTPUT TARGET.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb adds beside the intentional blank: NO BEHAVIORAL CONDITIONS.
PANEL 6 — Pixa reads the whole physical packet before it is digitized. PIXA: Both sections are measurable without inferred mental-state data. ASTRA: That's the point.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The Operations Liaison joins the review by live call from another StarTrust site. Middle image: LIAISON: This is not a standard pilot category. Closing image: The Liaison keeps reading.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Operations Liaison joins the review by live call from another StarTrust site.
PANEL 2 — Astra sends the fourth recommendation.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison reads silently for a moment.
PANEL 4 — Medium close on Liaison beside the active work surface, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. LIAISON: This is not a standard pilot category.
PANEL 5 — Astra answers. ASTRA: Neither are we.
PANEL 6 — The Liaison keeps reading. LIAISON: That is not an argument. ASTRA: The operating record is.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The Liaison reaches the budget comparison. Middle image: The bracket ETA sits open on a side screen. Closing image: Astra looks at the crew around the table. Nobody tells her what to choose.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison reaches the budget comparison.

PANEL 2 — Medium close on Liaison beside the temporary bracket and open equipment housing, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. LIAISON: Dedicated material pilot is the safer funding recommendation.
PANEL 3 — Astra knows exactly what that buys. LIAISON: Priority procurement. Dedicated support. Protected headcount.
PANEL 4 — The bracket ETA sits open on a side screen.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison continues. LIAISON: It also requires a target and program conditions.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at the crew around the table. Nobody tells her what to choose.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The Liaison asks directly. Middle image: ASTRA: Recommend the station we actually run. Closing image: Astra does not revise it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The Liaison asks directly. LIAISON: Which recommendation do you want me to carry?
PANEL 2 — Astra looks at Option One.
PANEL 3 — Then at the fourth recommendation.
PANEL 4 — Medium close on Astra beside the active work surface, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. ASTRA: Recommend the station we actually run.
PANEL 5 — The Liaison is explicit. LIAISON: That can lose.
PANEL 6 — Astra does not revise it. ASTRA: I know.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Central review returns written questions while the Liaison remains on the call. Middle image: Question: WHAT MATERIAL YIELD CAN BE COMMITTED?. Closing image: Question: THEN WHY RETAIN MATERIAL OBSERVATION? Mira looks at Astra. Astra lets her answer.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Central review returns written questions while the Liaison remains on the call.
PANEL 2 — Question: WHAT IS THE REPRODUCIBLE OUTPUT?
PANEL 3 — Astra answers. ASTRA: Operational response.
PANEL 4 — Question: WHAT MATERIAL YIELD CAN BE COMMITTED?
PANEL 5 — Mira answers. MIRA: None.
PANEL 6 — Question: THEN WHY RETAIN MATERIAL OBSERVATION? Mira looks at Astra. Astra lets her answer. MIRA: Because unknown is not the same as worthless.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The review asks for one concise value statement. Middle image: MIRA: And we measure the strange part without pretending we understand it. Closing image: KREEB: That do not require people to become records. Astra types.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The review asks for one concise value statement.
PANEL 2 — Astra starts typing, stops, and turns to the crew. ASTRA: Give me the plain answer.
PANEL 3 — Medium close on Zib beside the active work surface, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. ZIB: We keep the place working.
PANEL 4 — Medium close on Mira beside the active work surface, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. MIRA: And we measure the strange part without pretending we understand it.
PANEL 5 — Medium close on Glorp beside the active work surface, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. GLORP: With records.
PANEL 6 — Medium close on Kreeb beside the active work surface, expression readable and eyeline directed toward the others. KREEB: That do not require people to become records. Astra types.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra submits the final site recommendation. Middle image: The Liaison asks one last time. Closing image: She presses SUBMIT before any approval exists.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra submits the final site recommendation.
PANEL 2 — Central screen still displays the three standard options beside it.
PANEL 3 — The Liaison asks one last time. LIAISON: You are declining the dedicated material recommendation?
PANEL 4 — Astra answers. ASTRA: We have a fourth.
PANEL 5 — She presses SUBMIT before any approval exists.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: The review status changes to: UNDER EVALUATION. Middle image: Astra joins him for the scheduled temporary-bracket inspection. Closing image: Zib nods.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The review status changes to: UNDER EVALUATION.
PANEL 2 — Astra, Zib and Jax look from the UNDER EVALUATION status back to the still-open bracket panel.
PANEL 3 — Zib points at the still-open bracket panel. ZIB: Great. Hold this.
PANEL 4 — Astra joins him for the scheduled temporary-bracket inspection.
PANEL 5 — Jax takes the monitoring reader without being assigned. JAX: Six-minute interval?
PANEL 6 — Zib nods. ZIB: You remember. JAX: Unfortunately.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Montage across Stardust Station's ordinary working spaces during the pending review: maintenance bay, lab work area, quiet-room threshold and operations level. Opening image: The station keeps operating while the review remains pending; Zib and Jax continue the bracket inspection started on the prior page. Middle image: Kreeb returns the quiet-room chairs after someone borrowed them. Closing image: Astra glances once at the pending review on a distant screen, then turns the screen away and takes the work order. She does not refresh it again.
settingText: Montage across Stardust Station's ordinary working spaces during the pending review: maintenance bay, lab work area, quiet-room threshold and operations level.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The station keeps operating while the review remains pending; Zib and Jax continue the bracket inspection started on the prior page.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the temporary material filler at the actual repair and records only its physical condition. No new claim.
PANEL 3 — Glorp closes an ordinary safety record at a working counter.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb returns the quiet-room chairs after someone borrowed them.
PANEL 5 — Pixa reports routine uptime while passing Astra a normal work order that needs attention.
PANEL 6 — Astra glances once at the pending review on a distant screen, then turns the screen away and takes the work order. She does not refresh it again.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Pixa's notification tone sounds once. Middle image: Second line: PROGRAM: ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS / INCIDENTAL MATERIAL OBSERVATION. Closing image: Astra reads it without speaking for a beat. Zib breaks the silence.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa's notification tone sounds once.
PANEL 2 — Everyone looks toward the nearest screen.
PANEL 3 — Central review result: STATION STATUS: ACTIVE.
PANEL 4 — Second line: PROGRAM: ADAPTIVE OPERATIONS / INCIDENTAL MATERIAL OBSERVATION.
PANEL 5 — Third and fourth lines: OUTPUT TARGET: NONE / BEHAVIORAL CONDITIONS: NONE / PROCUREMENT: OPERATIONS PRIORITY.
PANEL 6 — Astra reads it without speaking for a beat. Zib breaks the silence. ZIB: Does active come with a bracket?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Maintenance Bay. Opening image: Pixa checks procurement. Middle image: Astra finally smiles. Closing image: Jax looks at the temporary repair tag.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa checks procurement.
PANEL 2 — The replacement request has changed: REPLACEMENT PART ETA: 2 DAYS.
PANEL 3 — Zib stares at the screen. ZIB: That's suspicious.
PANEL 4 — Astra finally smiles. ASTRA: Do not investigate procurement generosity.
PANEL 5 — Brick opens his notebook. BRICK: Too late.
PANEL 6 — Jax looks at the temporary repair tag. JAX: Two days. We may have to learn what permanent means. GLORP: Do not say that near policy.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Glorp and Kreeb build the durable reporting template for the approved program. Middle image: Glorp leaves BEHAVIORAL CONTEXT blank by rule and marks: NOT REQUIRED. Kreeb looks at the empty area. Closing image: Astra walks past carrying ordinary work orders.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp and Kreeb build the durable reporting template for the approved program.
PANEL 2 — Fields include: PHYSICAL CONDITIONS / SAMPLE PROPERTIES / OPERATIONAL EVENT / BEHAVIORAL CONTEXT.
PANEL 3 — Glorp leaves BEHAVIORAL CONTEXT blank by rule and marks: NOT REQUIRED. Kreeb looks at the empty area. KREEB: Intentional blank space.
PANEL 4 — Across the room, the vending machine prints an unsolicited receipt: STATION STATUS: ACTIVE. Brick turns slowly toward it.
PANEL 5 — Astra walks past carrying ordinary work orders. ASTRA: Normal enough.
